How long repairing every module takes; o.zh-CN: 修完所有模块的总时长，单个模块按比例分摊；设为 0 就是立刻修完
How long repairing every module takes; o.en-US: How long repairing every module takes; one module costs its share of that. Set 0 for an instant fix

Show the remaining repair time at the bo.zh-CN: 读条期间在屏幕底部显示剩余维修时间
Show the remaining repair time at the bo.en-US: Show the remaining repair time at the bottom of the screen while a repair is running

Write repair diagnostics to Bin/Mods/Rep.zh-CN: 把维修诊断写入 Bin/Mods/RepairMenu.debug.log，只在出问题时打开
Write repair diagnostics to Bin/Mods/Rep.en-US: Write repair diagnostics to Bin/Mods/RepairMenu.debug.log; only turn this on when something is wrong

Clean up automatically once the field ho.zh-CN: 场上残骸达到阈值后自动清理
Clean up automatically once the field ho.en-US: Clean up automatically once the field holds enough wrecks

How many vehicle wrecks have to be on th.zh-CN: 场上残骸达到多少辆才触发清理
How many vehicle wrecks have to be on th.en-US: How many vehicle wrecks have to be on the field before they are cleared

A wreck has to burn this long before it.zh-CN: 残骸要烧这么久才算可清理，保证击杀画面还能看到
A wreck has to burn this long before it.en-US: A wreck has to burn this long before it counts as clearable, so the kill is still watchable

Seconds between field sweeps.zh-CN: 两次扫描之间的间隔（秒）

Also mark the wreck as hidden so no stal.zh-CN: 同时把残骸标记为隐藏，战术地图上不留旧图标
Also mark the wreck as hidden so no stal.en-US: Also mark the wreck as hidden so no stale icon is left on the tactical map

Show the wrecks again while the after ac.zh-CN: 战后回放期间重新显示残骸（回放会拍到它们），结束后再隐藏
Show the wrecks again while the after ac.en-US: Show the wrecks again while the after action replay runs, since it films them, and hide them again afterwards

Switch the cleanup on or off during a mi.en-US: Switch the cleanup on or off during a mission

Write sweep diagnostics to Bin/Mods/Wrec.zh-CN: 把扫描诊断写入 Bin/Mods/WreckCleanup.debug.log，只在出问题时打开
Write sweep diagnostics to Bin/Mods/Wrec.en-US: Write sweep diagnostics to Bin/Mods/WreckCleanup.debug.log; only turn this on when something is wrong
